scope: Release validation remains pending; working-candidate checks below are complete.

checks.name: Portable source export
checks.detail: All 589 regenerated runtime files equal the prior tested HUD 1.1 installation byte-for-byte; no absolute source paths or game-frame extracts required.

checks.name: Exact live deployment
checks.detail: All 589 flat live files match asset-manifest.json. Exactly 38 inventoried unused files removed after a full flat-file backup. All 775 nested source files preserved.

checks.name: Sprite transparency
checks.detail: All 585 shipped PNGs have zero RGB under alpha zero. Normal sprite export preserves every alpha and visible RGBA value. Prior full audit covered 619 PNGs, with 358 needing cleanup.

checks.name: Missile export
checks.detail: All 90 poses reproduced at 1024 from nine neutral masters and authored halos; opaque source recipe checked for every pose.

checks.name: Approved subtargets
checks.detail: 393-409: original TGA hashes and deployed PNG hashes unchanged; exact 528x416 RGBA equality. Frame 406 remains Ion Cannon; no 410 replacement added.

checks.name: Portable Blender scenes
checks.detail: 34 selected base/wireframe scenes reopened with packed reference images and relative output paths. Original authoring scenes preserved.

checks.name: Engine source handoff
checks.detail: Complete patch against 4150676 reconstructs all eleven changed/added files byte-for-byte. Installed binary and launcher hashes unchanged.

checks.name: Existing launcher smoke test
checks.detail: Live HUD loaded at 1920x1080: 29 roots, 61 children; screenshot saved; normal exit code 0.

checks.name: Deployed instrument scene
checks.detail: Isolated mission 991 uses the deployed HUD and eight installed ship mods. Enlarged gunnery/text, solid synchronised bar, missile readout, radar and reticles visually inspected; exit code 0.

checks.name: Prior firing-mode and target tests
checks.detail: HUD 1.1 evidence confirms full/synchronised solid bars, interactive individual split bars, target brackets and screen-edge cue. All retained runtime bytes and engine are unchanged.

checks.name: Package guard tests
checks.detail: Nine existing package tests pass; package_mod.py --check still refuses the held release.

checks.name: Engine unit tests
checks.detail: Existing HUD 1.1 run passed 2042/2042; no engine changes or unnecessary rebuild in this handoff.

checks.name: Editable mission fixtures
checks.detail: All three preserved Zig fixture generators reproduce their checked-in DTE bytes exactly against the pinned engine source.

limitations: Final public release remains on hold; this is a deployed working candidate, not a release freeze.
Official OpenReliant v0.7.0 lacks the custom renderer; compatibility and engine upgrades belong to release preparation.
Final gameplay, campaign transitions, additional resolutions, missing-schematic fallback and fresh install/disable/uninstall checks remain HUD-QA-01 work.
17 large-schematic jobs covering 19 runtime names remain unfinished; fuel-pod frame 410 remains a separate review item.
1024 missile exports avoid the earlier 512 reduction, but fine texture detail remains limited by the selected neutral renders.
Subtarget byte/pixel verification does not substitute for gameplay testing of each target type.
Git LFS is unavailable; all repository files remain unstaged, with no first commit or GitHub remote/upload.
test_environment_notes: The live nested HUD/hud directory is intentionally preserved and ignored by the flat mod loader.
The isolated no-sound test directory omitted force-feedback files; its warnings do not indicate a HUD load failure.
